services.proposed_fix:
# Proposed fix (not applied)

## Diagnosis
`glm_generate.py:37` unconditionally reads catalogue entries for kept candidates, although stage 07 records fetch failures and can pass with those entries absent. The driver skips the passed sync stage on every resume, so rerunning generation alone repeats the same FileNotFoundError after paid calls. CeQJepmYkjQ failed subtitle fetching with HTTP 429. Seven chunk inputs lack catalogue entries; others include an unavailable format and a members-only video. This is an unhandled input/state dependency in our generator, not an evaluator defect.

## Precise implementation description
1. In `00_GLOSSARY_PIPELINE_CORE/scripts/glm_generate.py`, after constructing `cands` and before `load_env()`, `make_client()` or any model calls, validate that every selected video with kept candidate concepts has an existing, parseable catalogue entry validated against `video_catalogue_entry.schema.json`. Validate any required transcript dependency as well under the existing stage rules. Collect failures, read the corresponding outcomes/error_detail from `transcript_sync_report.json`, and exit with one actionable dependency error listing all affected IDs instead of crashing inside `video_prompt` after spending money.
2. In the driver's stage-08 resume/dependency handling, revalidate required bank files even when stage 07 has a PASS on disk. If missing, schedule stage-07 repair through the normal fetch and evaluation path rather than treating the stale PASS as sufficient. Retry HTTP 429 fetches using bounded backoff; stop for an operator decision on members-only/unavailable sources or exhausted retries. Do not fabricate catalogue/transcript data, silently drop candidates, or relax any evaluator, gate, ledger, or evidence check. If candidates must be replaced, regenerate and validate the affected upstream artifacts and chunk/parent dependencies through normal stages.
3. Regression tests: a kept candidate with a recorded failed fetch and no catalogue must produce a dependency diagnostic before any LLM call; a resumed run with stage-07 PASS but missing required bank files must enter repair; repaired valid inputs must preserve existing checks and output schema.

## Recovery
Have the maintainer apply and test the fix, repair the missing source dependencies (including resolving the inaccessible sources), and revalidate affected artifacts. Then rerun the original driver command so completed valid stages can be skipped. No code was edited and no pipeline rerun was attempted during read-only triage.
